propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate's cached consent snapshot change was followed by a fall in p95 response time on the transactions-history endpoint from 1,180 ms (1 to 28 February 2024) to 410 ms (1 to 28 April 2024), according to the gateway performance report obtained from the former employer.
propositions.rationale: The verification note records a report obtained from the employer with the endpoint, percentile, baseline and comparison windows and the candidate's authorship; the resume and pull request describe the change.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer credential, verified on the vendor's certification page.
propositions.rationale: The recruiter verification records a check of the credential with its validation number.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint, including consent checks and error mapping.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the service directly.

expectedGap: The documented endpoint work covers account-information endpoints; no payment-initiation endpoint work is described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the response-time result with its endpoint, percentile, February and April windows and the employer-supplied report, and keep the verified credential; do not extend the result to other endpoints or to payment initiation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has built or changed payment-initiation endpoints and what that work involved.
